FAQ

Service area questions

Which Ipswich suburbs do you service for lawn mowing?

Raceview, Ripley, Springfield Lakes, Redbank Plains, Brassall, Booval, Bundamba, Yamanto, Silkstone, Flinders View, Karalee, Collingwood Park, Goodna and surrounding suburbs across Ipswich City.

Do you service Springfield, Springfield Central and Brookwater?

Yes. The Springfield corridor including Springfield, Springfield Central, Springfield Lakes, Brookwater, Augustine Heights, Spring Mountain and Camira is covered on our eastern routes.

Do you mow in the rural suburbs west of Ipswich?

Yes. Rosewood, Walloon, Thagoona, Marburg, Haigslea, Willowbank, Peak Crossing, Purga and the surrounding rural suburbs are serviced, with acreage and larger blocks quoted on site.

What if my suburb isn't on a current route day?

Ask. Routes are built from the streets we already mow, so a new suburb usually joins the nearest route day once there are a couple of homes on it.

Leaf it to us, wherever you are in Ipswich.

Tell us your suburb and we'll confirm your route day with the quote.
